audit.whatIsWrong: Row 4 (Level 6) is given to Locke on both layers, but win[4]'s own why says "Level 6 stays even — your poke trades into his grey-health, and neither ult wins it outright yet", packet.levelChart says Skill, and spikes[1].when places his takeover at "Locke 6 + first item" — which is row 5, already marked Locke.
audit.why: As written the page awards him two consecutive rows for one spike and prints "stays even" underneath the first of them.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and win[4] -> Skill, as a matched pair. phases[4].why rewritten from a Locke-wins line to an even one keyed to the 120s ultimate.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: spikes[] has 3 entries where 4 are expected, and there is no cooldown sequencing anywhere except the E timer. The ultimate is named eight times and never given its 120/100/80s; the nail Q is the tracked focus of the whole page and never given its 10/9/8/7/6s.
audit.why: The page's core instruction is "commit while it is down" and the reader has no number for either of the two cooldowns it says to count. The missing fourth spike also leaves his one sustain window undocumented.
audit.corrected: 120s at rank 1 written into phases[4].why and breakdown.cooldowns; 10s at rank 1 into dosFull[2].d; E restated as a flat 10s. spikes[3] created (before:null) covering the W self-refund on 18s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t tells the reader "Anti-heal is optional — his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal". His W deals damage to himself and then heals back a portion of the damage taken during the effect; that is healing, and Grievous Wounds reduces it like any other. The kit file marks the W as an explicit anti-heal target.
audit.why: It is a shopping instruction that costs the player the item that beats his only sustain, and it is wrong on a rule the game applies uniformly.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now says anti-heal is not optional and names the W refund as the thing it cuts; spikes[3] repeats the timing.
sources: enemyKit W text "will heal back a portion of the damage he takes"
enemyKit W flag heal: "anti-heal target — Grievous Wounds timing matters"

audit.whatIsWrong: His R carries grounding as well as the execute, slow and zone. The page describes the totem purely as an execute floor and never mentions that it also shuts dashes off, which is what stops a teammate or a summoner-spell disengage from pulling you out of it.
audit.why: "Leave the zone" and "you cannot dash out of the zone" are different instructions.
audit.corrected: Not written this pass — see notes; I could not confirm from the kit text whether the grounding applies to the zone or only to the projectile, and the flag alone does not say.
sources: enemyKit R flags grounding, zone, execute, slow

notes: No mirror existed, so this file defines the chart locke__lillia must match: Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Locke, Skill — identical to packet.levelChart. UNVERIFIED, deliberately left alone: (1) the page calls Locke "a 125-range mana champ" in tldr, report[0].t, breakdown.early and breakdown.wave. packet.enemyAbilities is null and the kit file gives no attack range, so I could not confirm or refute 125 and did not touch those strings. (2) The ability names on this page — Ritual Nails, Ashen Pursuit, Purgatory — cannot be checked: the kit file for Locke carries slots and cooldowns but no names, and the packet has no enemyAbilities list. They may well be right; I simply have no authority to confirm them, so I wrote no new name into any string. (3) breakdown.cooldowns claimed his E "resets on takedowns"; that is not in Riot's text for the ability, so I dropped the clause rather than repeat it. (4) The R's grounding flag is real but its scope (projectile vs zone) is not stated, so I wrote nothing about dash denial.
